comment: Reviewed dependency allow-list for writ-keys (keys/DEPENDENCIES.md; M5a-05, D-045 M5-D6, M5-INTERFACES J-0/J-3). The closure covers normal and build dependencies; path dependencies on workspace members (writ-broker, and through it writ-kernel) are gated by their own allow-lists. Only rustix 1.1.6 (features std, fs) and its closure, all already approved for writ-broker with the same versions and checksums: no new registry package. 'Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT' is approved for rustix 1.1.6 and linux-raw-sys 0.12.1 only (owner decision 2026-11-12), not as a general licence.

rustix.role: direct runtime (openat2 with RESOLVE_BENEATH|NO_SYMLINKS|NO_MAGICLINKS|NO_XDEV, fstat, flistxattr for the POSIX ACL check, directory listing from a descriptor); default features off, features std and fs only; within the reviewed maximum set of M5-DEPENDENCY-REVIEW section 2; licence approved for this package only (owner decision 2026-11-12), used under its MIT option
rustix.licence_approved: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

linux-raw-sys.role: transitive (rustix linux_raw backend on Linux); licence approved for this package only (owner decision 2026-11-12), used under its MIT option
linux-raw-sys.licence_approved: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

bitflags.role: transitive (rustix); same version as approved for writ-broker

libc.role: transitive, target-specific (rustix and errno libc backend targets); not compiled for writ-keys on x86_64 Linux

errno.role: transitive, target-specific (rustix libc backend); not compiled on x86_64 Linux

windows-sys.role: transitive, Windows targets only (rustix, errno); not compiled on Linux

windows-link.role: transitive, Windows targets only (windows-sys); not compiled on Linux
